name: picture-in-picture
description: Show video in a floating window.
useCase: Open a video in a separate picture-in-picture window.
misuse: Do not use this action for fullscreen playback or a static image thumbnail.

16.reason: The open upper corner makes room for a complete entry arrow. A small inset window stays at least 1px from the outer frame.

24.reason: A longer complete arrow enters through the open corner, staying separate from the larger inset window and frame.
